style: Stylized heroic fantasy painting in the look of a hand-painted 2D animated fantasy cinematic short: bold simplified shapes, slightly heroic sturdy proportions (broad shoulders, solid armour and props), heavy confident painterly brush strokes, hand-painted textures, rich saturated colour with a limited palette per scene, strong warm rim light against deep cool shadows, big areas of calm empty darkness, atmospheric haze between clear foreground, middle ground and background layers, cinematic widescreen composition. No ink outlines and no comic line art: edges are defined only by paint and light. Grounded anatomy and believable faces with real weight and emotion, semi-realistic like a painted cinematic short, not a cartoon, not a comic, not photorealistic, not a book illustration. Full-bleed image edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no text, no letters, no logos, no borders, no frame, no watermark.

cast.lucien: Lucien Vale, a young half-elf wild magic sorcerer who loves to sing and play music, a good-hearted man who was betrayed: long straight blond hair, pointed elf ears, clean-shaven handsome face with fine elven features and a straight, slim, normal-sized nose, lively expressive eyes, burgundy velvet long coat with brass buttons over a dark shirt, leather belt with a dagger whose blade glows faintly blue, faint purple arcane sparks flickering at his fingertips, a wooden flute at his belt, slim build. His face is full of life and follows the scene: shouting, laughing, fierce, cocky, scheming, grieving only when the scene grieves. Sympathetic hero, never sinister or villainous
cast.arthas: Arthas, a tall devout human paladin: full dark steel plate armour, a dark cloth hood always worn up over a closed steel helm (hood visible in every view), two burning orange eye slits, broad shoulders, heavy bronze-hilted longsword, a faded holy sun emblem on his chest
cast.cedric: Cedric 'Cold-Eye', a human monk: shaved head, short dark beard, hard pale grey eyes, red and brown leather monk wraps over a green tunic, one bronze dragon-shaped shoulder pauldron, prayer beads, a long wooden staff, wiry strong build
cast.drow: Nerrissa, a beautiful drow woman: dark purple-grey skin, long straight white hair, pointed ears, violet eyes, a fitted dark leather outfit with silver details, a sly smile, a monster hunter with two curved silver blades
cast.wittan: Wittan, a deep gnome (svirfneblin): small, grey stone-coloured skin, bald, big nose and ears, dark eyes, practical grey leathers and a pick
cast.valerys: Oathbreaker Valerys, the High Inquisitor fallen: a tall man in his sixties, close-cropped grey hair and short grey beard, hard pale grey eyes, his white and crimson inquisitor robes and gold sun emblem blackened and cracked, dark corrupted plate beneath, a cold dark fire and pale light burning around him; here his armour is torn to pieces and he is badly wounded, a glowing golden sword in his hand
cast.serpent: the serpent: a colossal pale worm-like serpent rising from the earth, ridged grey-white hide, a huge round mouth ringed with teeth, dirt and stones falling from it
cast.dolkan: Dolkan, a mad old duergar sorcerer, a real living creature at full size (not a miniature, no base, no plastic): short and very stocky, grey stone-like skin, bald with a single tuft of hair on top, an enormous wild bushy white beard and huge bushy eyebrows braided with small beads, a long drooping moustache, glowing white eyes, a scarred face, a heavy hooded cloak worn with the hood down and a round sigil clasp at the shoulder, layered dark robes, a wide belt with a round studded buckle, a dagger, rings on his fingers, boots with curled-up toes, a twisted gnarled wooden staff crowned with a cluster of pale crystals, faint violet spores swirling from his free hand
cast.young_valerys: Valerys twenty years younger, about forty: the same face as in his reference (hard pale grey eyes, strong jaw, short beard) but jet-black close-cropped hair and a short black beard, no grey; a High Inquisitor of Tyr: white and crimson robes over plate armour, a gold sun emblem; strong, proud, grief-stricken
cast.young_valerys_bare: Valerys twenty years younger, exactly the face, hair and beard of his reference (jet-black close-cropped hair, short black beard, hard pale grey eyes), but his plate armour, cloak and tabard stripped off and cast aside: only a sweat-soaked plain off-white linen shirt open at the throat, sleeves pushed up, dark breeches, bare-headed, no armour, no cloak, no emblem; strong, proud, grief-stricken
cast.boy_arthas: Arthas as a small boy of six: slight and pale, tousled light brown hair, serious pale grey eyes like his father's, a solemn little face, a plain linen nightshirt
cast.boy_cedric: Cedric as a small boy of five: short dark hair (not yet shaved), pale grey eyes, a thin pale face, a plain linen nightshirt
